in_arabic.name: قاشد
in_arabic.long_meaning: One who is eager, anxious, or desirous. This name is derived from the Arabic root 'q-sh-d', which carries the meaning of 'haste' or 'desire'. In the context of Islamic names, it can be interpreted as a name for one who is eager to please Allah or desirous of attaining His pleasure.
